decision: The upstream fix changes a modern MDC outer-overlay CSS cascade. Owned legacy markup binds an inline geometry-derived transform origin and its above fallback sets a bottom origin; the offending MDC pane selector is absent from the reviewed owned select styles. This is a source distinction only and does not assert nested-overlay runtime equivalence.
